test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between H and B when counted from the right of H. Only three people sit between A and C when counted from the right of C. B sits to the immediate right of C. G sits to the immediate right of I. Who sits fourth to the right of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only two people sit between H and B when counted from the right of H. 

2) B sits to the immediate right of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df0ca6e5973c36ee7ec795d981d14ef04b1947fd95f0c73cf0e3664faf6d22fe.png] 

3) Only three people sit between A and C when counted from the right of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b9d5701678ce1f5d771d2fc0524874b0a383e70717554f950ff5d650c08dde.png] 

4) G sits to the immediate right of I.

After positioning G and I only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/589c9119f51904a42f22c3c9d6ce849f8c9b0055071cd05fc6b1707fe3d4dc8f.png] 

Thus, G sits fourth to the right of D.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
